Welcome to Cyrus Says!
Stand-up comedian Punit Pania joins Cyrus Broacha for a lively, irreverent conversation about Indian politics, public protests and the everyday absurdities of modern life.
The duo discuss the Jantar Mantar protests, police detentions, the importance of democratic dissent and whether political crackdowns can backfire. They debate EVMs versus paper ballots, voter-list verification, airport renaming and the evolving political landscape.
